rules.statement: A mortgage on property that was subsequently set aside due to the mortgagor's consent and action, rather than laesio enormis or other vendor-initiated rescission, remains valid.
rules.supporting_quote: "In this connection I would invite attention to the distinction drawn between contracts that are void and those that are voidable in the 18th edition of Anson's Law of Contract, pp. 4 & 5. As the transaction between the 1st and 3rd defendants was not void, but merely voidable, Nagarajah obtained a good title."
